downscroll_desc: If enabled, notes will scroll downward instead of upward.
rating_offset_desc: Adjust the timing window (in milliseconds) for achieving a 'Sick!' rating.
loading_style_desc: Set the transition style for scene changes.
rm_ms_offset_desc:
Remove the 'xx ms' display when hitting notes.
Useful for specific mods.
scoretxt_bounce_desc: Add angular bounce effects to the score text when hitting notes.
scoretxt_style_desc: Modify the visual style of the score text.
iconbop_style_desc: Customize the bounce animation style for icons.
iconbop_normalize_desc: Make the icon bounce/scale rebound frame-rate independent (consistent on high refresh rate displays). When OFF, uses the legacy per-frame formula.
healthbar_style_desc: Change the visual appearance of the health bar.
change_language_desc:
Select the display language.
Restart the options menu to apply changes.
single_splashanim_desc: Force all notes to use a single splash animation.
smooth_hpbar_desc: Make the health bar transitions smoother.
showcase_style_desc: Configure the display style for the showcase screen.
cpu_strums_desc: Enable hit effects for bot arrows.
botplaytxt_style_desc: Change the visual effects for the BOTPLAY text display.
fpstxt_style_desc: Modify the font style of the FPS counter.
show_version_desc: Display the current version next to the FPS counter.
focus_game_desc: Pause the game when the window loses focus.
show_exrating_desc:
Display additional rating graphics.
File naming example: sick-extra.png.
Avoid enabling in pixel scenarios unless corresponding textures are available.
rating_bounce_desc:
Enhance the bounce animation for rating icons.
Note: This option may have known issues; disabling is recommended.
exrating_bounce_desc:
Enhance the bounce animation for extended rating icons.
Note: This option may have stability issues.
rating_opac_desc: Adjust the opacity of rating textures (100% = original opacity).
rm_perfect_judge_desc:
Perfect judgement mode
off=Normal (Perfect as separate rating)
remove=Remove Perfect entirely
sickPlus=Perfect becomes Sick+ (counts as Sick, gives Perfect score, optional Perfect texture)
timebar_style_desc: Modify the visual style of the timebar in gameplay.
request_admin_desc:
Restart game with administrator privileges
Enabling will prompt for UAC confirmation. After confirmation, the program will restart with elevated privileges
The window title bar will display "(Administrator)" badge
wintitle_dynamic: Update the window title with the current screen, loaded mod and (while playing) the current song. Disabled automatically when Fake OS Mode is on.
wintitle_state: Display the name of the current screen/state in the window title (e.g. Main Menu, Freeplay).
wintitle_mod: Display the currently loaded mod's name in the window title.
wintitle_song: While playing, display the current song's name in the window title (real-time).
wintitle_difficulty: While playing, also show the current song's difficulty next to its name.
scoretextlanguage_desc: The UI language used for score text (scoreTxt). 'Auto' follows the game language.
charting_charting_tip: Any options here won't actually affect gameplay!
charting_legacy_only4key_cur: Legacy export only supports 4-key charts (current is {0}-key).
charting_legacy_only4key_sec: Legacy export only supports 4-key charts (section uses {0}-key).
charting_legacy_notchart: Error: File loaded is not a Psych Engine chart.
charting_msg_notchart: Error: File loaded is not a Psych Engine/FNF 0.2.x.x chart.
charting_msg_noteventfile: Error: File loaded is not a Psych Engine chart/events file.
charting_msg_reload_noneed: You must save/load a Chart first to Reload it!
charting_msg_autosave_invalid: Error: File loaded is not a valid Psych Engine autosave.
charting_msg_autosave_notfound: Error! Autosave file selected could not be found.
charting_msg_vslice_notchart: Error: File loaded is not a valid FNF V-Slice chart.
charting_msg_vslice_notmeta: Error: File loaded is not a valid FNF V-Slice metadata.
charting_msg_vslice_nodiff: Error: You need at least one difficulty to export.
charting_msg_selectnotes: You must select notes to move them!
charting_msg_note_must_event: Note selected must be an Event!
charting_msg_single_event: You must select a single event to press this button.
charting_msg_event_del_weird: Weird: No event was selected when you deleted it.
charting_msg_morethanoneside: You cannot press this button with notes on more than one side.
charting_msg_loadvalid_preview: Load a valid song to preview!
arrow_colormode_desc: RGB = new palette colors; HSV = legacy Psych v0.6.3 hue/saturation/brightness shift
charting_mobile_tips:
Up/Down - Move Conductor's Time
Left/Right - Change Sections
Up/Down (On The Right) - Decrease/Increase Note Sustain Length
Hold Y to Increase/Decrease move by 4x

C - Preview Chart
A - Playtest Chart
X - Stop/Resume Song

Hold H and touch to Select Note(s)
Z - Hide Action TouchPad Buttons
V/D - Zoom in/out

${FLX_PITCH?G - Reset Song Playback Rate:}
charting_desktop_tips:
W/S/Mouse Wheel - Move Conductor's Time
A/D - Change Sections
Q/E - Decrease/Increase Note Sustain Length
Hold Shift/Alt to Increase/Decrease move by 4x

F12 - Preview Chart
Enter - Playtest Chart
Space - Stop/Resume song

Alt + Click - Select Note(s)
Shift + Click - Select/Unselect Note(s)
Right Click - Selection Box

R - Reset Section
Shift + R - Go Back to the Start of the Song
Z/X - Zoom in/out
Left/Right - Change Snap
Left Bracket / Right Bracket - Change Song Playback Rate
ALT + Left Bracket / Right Bracket - Reset Song Playback Rate

Ctrl + Z - Undo
Ctrl + Y - Redo
Ctrl + X - Cut Selected Notes
Ctrl + C - Copy Selected Notes
Ctrl + V - Paste Copied Notes
Ctrl + A - Select all in current Section
Ctrl + S - Quicksave
prompt_warning: Warning: Any unsaved progress will be lost.
prompt_delete_notes: Delete all Notes in the song?
prompt_delete_events: Delete all Events in the song?
charactereditor_move_faster: Hold C - Move Offsets 10x faster and Camera 4x faster
charactereditor_undo_offset: Ctrl + Z - Undo Last Paste or Reset
prompt_new_text:
There's unsaved progress,
are you sure you want to exit?
prompt_startover: Are you sure you want to start over?
prompt_unsaved:
Warning: Any unsaved progress
will be lost.
prompt_deleteallnote: Delete all Notes in the song?
prompt_deleteallevent: Delete all Events in the song?
low_quality_desc:
If enabled, disables some background details, decreases loading times, and improves performance.
Note: Some mods may not be optimized for this setting.
antialiasing_desc: If unchecked, disables anti-aliasing, increasing performance at the cost of sharper visuals.
shaders_desc: If unchecked, disables shaders. Some visual effects may be affected.
gpu_caching_desc: If enabled, allows GPU to cache textures, reducing RAM usage. Not recommended for low-end GPUs.
framerate_desc: Set the maximum framerate for the game.
fps_rework_desc: If enabled, prevents the game from becoming 'slow' and 'smooth' when FPS is below cap.
fps_warning_1:
Warning: Recommended FPS range is 60-240
Because Psych Engine is designed this way
fps_warning_2:
Ah, if you insist on tweaking it this way, then suit yourself~
——KittyCathy
notesplash_desc: Select your preferred Note Splash variation.
notesplashopacity_desc: How transparent should the Note Splashes be.
hidehud_desc: If checked, hides most HUD elements.
timebar_desc: What should the Time Bar display?
flashinglights_desc: Uncheck this if you're sensitive to flashing lights!
camerazooms_desc: If unchecked, the camera won't zoom in on a beat hit.
scoretextgrow_desc:
If unchecked, disables the Score text growing
every time you hit a note.
healthbaropacity_desc: How transparent should the health bar and icons be.
vsync_desc:
If checked, Enables VSync fixing any screen tearing at the cost of capping FPS to screen refresh rate.
(Must restart game to have an effect)
pausemusic_desc: What song do you prefer for the Pause Screen?
checkforupdates_desc: On Release builds, turn this on to check for updates when you start the game.
discordrpc_desc: Uncheck this to prevent accidental leaks, it will hide the Application from your "Playing" box on Discord
combostacking_desc:
If unchecked, Ratings and Combo won't stack, saving on System Memory and making them easier to read.
Disabling this will also automatically disable rating bounce options
(such as Rating Bounce and Extra-Rating Bounce).
middlescroll_desc: If checked, your notes get centered.
opponentnotes_desc: If unchecked, opponent notes get hidden.
ghosttapping_desc:
If checked, you won't get misses from pressing keys
while there are no notes able to be hit.
autopause_desc: If checked, the game automatically pauses if the screen isn't on focus.
popupscore_desc:
If unchecked, hitting notes won't make "sick", "good".. and combo popups
(Useful for low-end devices).
disablereset_desc: If checked, pressing Reset won't do anything.
keyviewer_desc: Show a key indicator on the play screen (JKPS-style), following your actual key bindings.
keyviewer_profile_desc: Show images/keyviewer/icon.png (rounded) on the left and a custom name at the bottom (edit it in images/keyviewer/name.txt). No gap is left on the left when there is no icon.
keyviewer_reset_total_desc: Reset the cumulative key Total back to 0.
keyviewer_trail_desc: Direction of the key trail (white block): Auto is OPPOSITE to the in-game downscroll setting, Up forces upward from the key top, Down forces downward from the key bottom.
keyviewer_pos_desc: Open a screen to drag the Key Viewer panel with mouse or touch to reposition it. Saved automatically.
keyviewer_cal_hint_mobile:
Drag the panel below to adjust the Key Viewer position.
B (bottom-right) = Save & Back · C (bottom-left) = Reset to default
keyviewer_cal_hint_desktop:
Drag the panel below to adjust the Key Viewer position (mouse or touch).
R = Reset to default · ESC / BACK = Save & Back
gameovervibration_desc: If checked, your device will vibrate at game over.
sustainsasone_desc:
If checked, Hold Notes can't be pressed if you miss,
and count as a single Hit/Miss.
Uncheck this if you prefer the old Input System.
hitsoundvolume_desc: Funny notes does "Tick!" when you hit them.
ratingoffset_desc:
Changes how late/early you have to hit for a "Sick!"
Higher values mean you have to hit later.
perfectwindow_desc: Adjust the timing window (in milliseconds) for achieving a 'Perfect!!' rating.
sickwindow_desc:
Changes the amount of time you have
for hitting a "Sick!" in milliseconds.
goodwindow_desc:
Changes the amount of time you have
for hitting a "Good" in milliseconds.
badwindow_desc:
Changes the amount of time you have
for hitting a "Bad" in milliseconds.
hitwindowpreset_desc:
Apply preset hit-window timings with one click
Leather / Psych / Funkin'
safeframes_desc:
Changes how many frames you have for
hitting a note earlier or late.
flashing_warning_text:
Hey, watch out!
This Engine contains some flashing lights!
Do you wish to enable them?
ratbounce_combo_error: Rating Bounce requires Combo Stacking enabled!
exratbounce_combo_error: Extra-Rating Bounce requires Combo Stacking enabled!
adjust_delay_combo_desc: Calibrate note/beat delay and adjust the display position of combo and judgment
adjust_rating_offset_desc: Tap to the beat to measure and set your input delay
ratingoffset_cal_warmup: Get ready... tap on the beat
ratingoffset_cal_applied: Applied! Rating Offset set to {0} ms
graphics_desc: Adjust resolution, framerate, and quality settings
visuals_desc: Modify visual effects and HUD elements
window_manager_desc: Create, close, and manage multiple extra windows (Windows only)
fps_position_desc: Set the position of the FPS counter on screen
fps_spacing_desc: Adjust the spacing between FPS counter and screen edges
camhud_zoom_desc: Adjust the zoom level of HUD elements.
legacy_notepos_desc: Use the old note position system.
charting_version_desc:
Which Chart Editor to open.
0.7.3 and 0.6.3 recreate the older editors and only support 4-key charts.
ratings_pos_desc: Set the position of the ratings on screen.
events_debug_desc:
(Experimental Feature)
Sacrifices some performance to display event information. Only shows in Charting Mode!
firstlaunch_warning: This mod contains flashing effects that may cause discomfort
bot_addscore_desc:
If enabled, when bot hits notes, the score will increase.
(Doesn't count towards the final score.)
botplay_perfect_timing_desc:
If enabled, bot play hit timing will display as 0ms.
Also affects hit history records.
use_system_cursor_desc: If enabled, the game will use your system's default mouse cursor.
mods_import_desc:
(Experimental Feature)
If enabled, you can import mods by dragging and dropping mod ZIP files.
hud_zoomstyle_desc: Adjust the zoom style of the HUD elements.
bgvol_desc:
Enable background volume adjustment.
This requires 'Auto Pause' to be disabled.
bgvol_level_desc:
Adjust the volume of the game when it is in the background.
Same as above, requires 'Auto Pause' to be disabled.
gameplay_combospr_desc: Add a 'Combo' pop-up effect when hitting arrows.
fixed_timestep_desc:
Use fixed timestep
May alleviate frame drops, but causes game visual lag at low FPS
ratcounter_desc: Enable the rating counter to display the number of hits for each rating type.
watermark_desc: Show a watermark on the gameplay screen.
force_hold_animations_desc: Play animation only once when arrow is hit, no need for hold animation
show_haxelibs_desc: Display haxelib libraries and versions in FPS counter
keep_sing_animation_desc: Keep sing animation without returning to idle (for Hyperactive achievement)
resource_caching_desc: Cache resources when reloading songs to speed up loading times
enable_game_log_desc: Enable in-game log display (Press F3 to toggle)
fps_text_color_desc: Change the color of FPS counter text
fps_bg_color_desc: Change the color of FPS counter background
fps_text_opacity_desc: Adjust the opacity of FPS counter text
fps_bg_opacity_desc: Adjust the opacity of FPS counter background
fps_font_size_desc: Change the font size of FPS counter
fps_bg_padding_desc: Adjust padding around FPS counter text
fps_force_mb_desc: Always display memory in MB instead of auto-scaling to GB
fps_position_desc: Set the position of the FPS counter on screen
fps_spacing_desc: Adjust the spacing between FPS counter and screen edges
simpleinfo_text_color_desc: Change the text color of Simple FPS counter
simpleinfo_font_size_desc: Change the font size of Simple FPS counter
simpleinfo_show_mem_desc: Toggle memory usage and peak display
lane_cover_p1_desc: Transparency of the shadow/cover overlay on your lane. 0 = off, 1 = darkest.
lane_cover_p2_desc: Transparency of the shadow/cover overlay on the opponent's lane. 0 = off, 1 = darkest.
lane_cover_strum_alpha_desc: When enabled, the cover overlay opacity is multiplied by the receptor's own alpha (darkens automatically with middleScroll etc.).
precise_hit_desc: Millisecond-accurate hit timing: judges notes using the audio clock at the exact moment of input and recomputes the hit window live, removing ~1 frame of judgment lag and edge mis-hits.
input_system_desc: Select the input judgment system. Default = classic (notes ordered by time, nearest first). Rhythm = only the note closest to the strum line can be hit; others trigger a Miss.
gc_on_resume_desc: Force a garbage collection pass when the game resumes (may cause a brief hitch on resume).
hold_release_instant_miss_desc: Only effective with Sustains as One Note on: releasing a hold during its body instantly counts as a Miss (stricter and more immediate than vanilla).
hold_tail_judge_desc: The hold tail also counts as a valid hit: hitting the tail adds combo and shows a rating (no score); failing to hit it in time still breaks combo and misses.
hold_score_bonus_desc: Continue gaining score while holding a sustain note until it ends (similar to vanilla Funkin, roughly 250 score per second).
hold_tail_leniency_desc: When enabled, the hold tail judgment (by release timing) gets an extra lenient window. Requires Hold Tail Judgement.
hold_tail_leniency_ms_desc: Leniency in milliseconds for the hold tail judgment: each rating window and the hit window upper bound are extended by this amount (default 20, range 0-50).
hold_note_tail_fix_desc: Hold-note tail judgment fix: corrects tail timing so you don't drop the hold even if held until the visible tail. off = vanilla, extend = extend end to visible tail, earlyHit = loosen late end, both = both.
mobilejudgmentcomp_desc: Automatically adds a judgment offset on touch input to compensate for touch latency.
mobilejudgmentoffset_desc: Touch input judgment compensation amount (in milliseconds).
hitsound_desc: Select the hitsound played when you hit a note.
shitwindow_desc: Bottom fallback judgment window; also the fixed upper bound for safeZoneOffset.
useshitwindow_desc: When enabled, safeZoneOffset uses the Shit Window fixed value instead of being computed from Safe Frames.
softedge_desc: Enables soft interpolation on the outermost 20% of each judgment window to avoid judgment jumps at the boundary.
developer_mode_desc: Enable to access the editor menu (chart/character/stage...). In legacy main menu, shows the toolbox entry.
show_mode_label_ms_desc: Show (BOT) or (REPLAY) label in the ms timing text.
ghost_effect_desc: Show a ghost afterimage of the character when hitting multiple notes at once.
health_overflow_desc: Requires Smooth HP Bar. Lets health exceed 100% on dense charts and pushes the health icons past the bar edges.
health_overflow_drain_desc: How fast the overfilled health eases back to 100%. Higher = quicker. Requires Smooth HP Bar + Health Overflow Icons.
smooth_hp_speed_desc: How tightly the health bar eases to the real health. Higher = snappier (less lag). Requires Smooth HP Bar.
stage_quality_desc: Vector/text rendering quality (StageQuality). Lower = faster on mobile but blurrier text. Applies live; a restart re-renders everything.
combo_sprite_pooling_desc: Reuse rating/combo/number sprites instead of creating and destroying them on every hit. ON = smoother (less GC / less hit-stutter). OFF for max compatibility if a mod misbehaves with recycled sprites.
combo_sprite_pool_size_desc: Max sprites in the pool. 0 = unlimited (grow as needed). >0 = rotating mode (reuse oldest when full). Higher = more memory, lower = more recycling overhead. Typical: 16-64.
auto_song_resync_desc: On weak devices, the engine jumps the song back when audio/logic desyncs. Turn OFF to avoid sudden rewinds and rely on manual calibration.
hide_missed_notes_desc: Stop drawing notes already missed and scrolled off-screen. Lowers render load in SPAM charts. Misses are still counted.
low_latency_desc: Turns OFF auto resync (no rewinds), forces missed-note culling, instant-resolve of expired notes AND disables per-note scripts. Lowest latency at the cost of possible drift and modchart callbacks.
instant_resolve_expired_desc: Notes past the miss window are settled immediately instead of drawn for a few frames. Prevents lag-spiral avalanches in SPAM charts. Judgement unaffected.
disable_note_lua_desc: Skip Lua/HScript callbacks (onSpawnNote / goodNoteHit / noteMiss / opponentNoteHit) for every note. Big boost in dense charts. WARNING: breaks modcharts relying on these callbacks.
max_notes_per_frame_desc: Cap how many note sprites can be created in one frame (0 = unlimited). After a lag spike the backlog spreads over several frames. Notes are never dropped, only delayed a frame or two.
note_optimization_desc: Comprehensive note performance optimization: container optimizations, trig/timing caches, and memory layout improvements (does not change note object lifecycle; script-safe). Turning it off falls back fully to the original logic for easier troubleshooting.
note_pooling_desc: ⚠ Only enable if you are sure your chart/modchart does not rely on persistent note object references. When on, normal notes are reused per-column-bucket to eliminate GC stutter; if a script's onSpawnNote/goodNoteHit/noteMiss keeps a Note reference across spawns, it may read stale reused data.
ratcounter_anim_desc: Play a small animation when the rating counter updates.
enable_console_log_desc: Output game logs to the system console (terminal).
time_bar_gradient_desc: Only works with Psych style. Gradient from opponent color to player color.
ba_language_desc: Select language for Blue Archive loading transition.
bigger_info_text_desc: When toggled, the time bar uses a larger font.
startup_splash_desc: Choose the startup splash: Custom Logo = Kathy intro animation; Flixel = Flixel built-in splash; None = go straight into the game.
optimized_note_loading_desc: Auto-detects high-density charts and uses optimized loading. OFF = always legacy, ON = always optimized, AUTO = based on chart NPS.
playstate_adaptive_width_desc: Allows PlayState to adapt its width to the window (960-1680px), height locked at 720. Better display on wider screens.
chart_editor_follow_window_desc: When ON, the Chart Editor resolution follows the window size (720p-1080p adaptive). When OFF, uses the game default fixed resolution (1280x720).
splash_limit_desc: Limit the maximum number of simultaneous note splashes. OFF = no limit.
max_splashes_desc: Maximum number of note splashes that can exist at once. Only works when Splash Limit is ON.
loading_threads_desc: Number of threads used to preload assets when entering a song (1 = single-threaded; higher = more parallel loading but uses more memory).
show_loading_screen_desc: Show the loading screen transition when entering a song. Disable to skip it and switch directly (may cause a brief freeze while assets load).
hold_cover_skin_desc: Select the Hold Cover skin to use. Requires holdCover/holdCover{Color}{Skin}.png and optional .json configs.
three_icons_desc: Enables 3-state health icons: Normal / Lose / Win. The icon image should be a wide rectangle with the three states left-to-right. You can also use a 450x150 sheet of 3 square icons. When disabled, classic 2-state square icons are used.
load_leather_icons_desc: Prioritize Leather Engine format icons (leather/<name>-icons.png) over default. Mods' leather icons take priority automatically. Falls back to default if not found.
opponent_splashes_desc: Show NoteSplash effects when opponent hits notes. Requires CPU Strums visible. Compatible with playOpponent mode.
hold_covers_desc: Show a glow effect on the receptor while holding sustain notes, with a burst animation at the end of the hold. (Like vanilla FNF)
opponent_hold_covers_desc: Show Hold Cover effects on the opponent's side too. Requires CPU Strums and Hold Covers enabled.
fps_counter_style_desc: Choose between Psych (detailed) or Simple (Leather) style.
fps_settings_button_desc: Customize Psych style FPS counter appearance and content.
simple_info_settings_button_desc: Customize Simple (Leather) style FPS counter appearance and content.
disable_networking_desc: Blocks all internet usage at once: update checks, tip fetches, external links and Discord RPC.
legacy_main_menu_desc: Use the old Psych Engine v0.7.3 main menu style.
fake_os_mode_desc: Fake an operating system style for the window/chrome.
fake_window_title_desc: Preset window title shown when Fake OS Mode is on.
fake_os_version_desc: Preset OS version string shown when Fake OS Mode is on.
single_hold_note_animation_desc: Only play confirm animation once when holding long notes.
auto_reset_strum_anim_desc: Automatically reset strum notes to default animation (both normal taps and hold notes).
fallback_perfect_to_sick_desc:
If a mod doesn't have perfect/marvelous rating images, use the sick image instead.
In Sick+ mode: OFF=Show Perfect texture, ON=Show Sick texture.
fallback_experfect_to_sick_desc:
If a mod doesn't have ex-perfect/ex-marvelous rating images, use the sick image instead.
In Sick+ mode: OFF=Show Perfect texture, ON=Show Sick texture.
sound_tray_style_desc: Choose the style of the sound tray.
hold_note_behind_desc: Place hold notes behind normal notes and strum arrows.
extra_controls_desc: Select how many extra buttons you prefer. They can be used for mechanics with LUA or HScript.
mobile_controls_opacity_desc: Selects the opacity for the mobile buttons (careful not to put it at 0 and lose track of your buttons).
allow_phone_screensaver_desc: If checked, the phone will sleep after going inactive for a few seconds (time depends on your phone's options).
wide_screen_mode_desc: If checked, the game will stretch to fill your whole screen. WARNING: can result in bad visuals and break some mods that resize the game/cameras.
hitbox_design_desc: Choose how your hitbox should look like.
hitbox_position_desc: If checked, the hitbox will be put at the bottom of the screen, otherwise stays at the top.
hitbox_animation_desc: If checked, hitbox buttons will have animation when pressed/released.
dynamic_controls_color_desc: If checked, the mobile controls color is set to the notes color in your settings (effect during gameplay only).
rating_fall_style_desc: Falling style of the rating/number popups when 'Combo Stacking' is disabled. Legacy: uses downward velocity (current default). Kathy: only drops a fixed distance (closer to the ms-number bounce feel). Camellia: pops in place with a scale rebound and a fixed fade rhythm (recreated from VSCam).
camellia_scale_mode_desc: Scale basis for the Camellia style. Proportional: keeps the engine's current size and only adds the rebound animation. Original: uses VSCam's raw values, making the rating sprite noticeably smaller for the most faithful look.
